title: Intercollege Pencak Silat tournament culminates at KU

ai.summary: The University of Kashmir concluded a two-day Intercollege Pencak Silat tournament with over 15 colleges participating, highlighting student martial arts excellence and sportsmanship.

facts.claim: The two-day Intercollege Pencak Silat Men & Women Tournament, organised by the Directorate of Physical Education and Sports (DPE&S)University of Kashmir (KU)concluded on Wednesday.
facts.quote: The two-day Intercollege Pencak Silat Men & Women Tournament, organised by the Directorate of Physical Education and Sports (DPE&S)University of Kashmir (KU)concluded on Wednesday.

facts.claim: The championship held annually to promote martial arts among college students, witnessed enthusiastic participation from over 15 affiliated colleges, including the Post Graduate contingent of the University.
facts.quote: The championship held annually to promote martial arts among college students, witnessed enthusiastic participation from over 15 affiliated colleges, including the Post Graduate contingent of the University.

facts.claim: Across the two days, as per a KU statement, players demonstrated remarkable discipline, precision and athletic excellence in various competitive and artistic events of Pencak Silat.
